candidates.snippet: Russian forces hit Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 40 times, wounding four people. In Dnipro, warehouses, a shopping center, and apartment buildings were damaged, with a 59-year-old man and a 50-year-old woman hospitalized. Two more were injured in the Nikopol area. https://t.co/yQI
Ukraine’s HUR strike drone unit found a Russian fuel and ammo depot in Zaporizhzhia region, then on the next sortie epically destroyed the building and its stockpiles. https://t.co/UWtBqcqxsf

Moldova’s border service says multiple drones violated the country’s airspace overnight, at least three. It also says a drone crashed in the morning about 1.5 to 2 km from the Ukraine–Moldova border near the Ukrainian village of Troitske. https://t.co/6lHpQZjxXc
